name: Publication-scale CloudSim Plus campaign
scientific_architecture: Frozen from E3.12 and runtime-parity validated in E4.1c

scenarios.S2_HIDDEN_COMPUTE_40LOSS: six preselected nodes silently retain 60% compute capacity
scenarios.S3_HIDDEN_NETWORK_50LOSS: six preselected nodes silently retain 50% bandwidth
scenarios.S4_COMPOUND: arrival rate doubles and six preselected nodes simultaneously retain 60% compute and 50% bandwidth

primary_metrics: Mission post/late family-wise candidate coverage for assurance methods

statistics.omnibus: Friedman test across policies for Mission deadline violation rate
statistics.multiple_testing: Holm correction for FULL-vs-baseline paired comparisons

network_model_note: CloudSim Plus executes compute and queue dynamics. End-to-end network latency remains the explicit algebraic endpoint component used by the frozen E3 architecture; hidden bandwidth shifts affect this component without being exposed to the scheduler.
counterfactual_note: Counterfactual retained-candidate outcomes are simulator audit-only. They never update the scheduler, calibrator, health detector, or E1.7 memory.
